setup_command: python -m venv .clawgap-venv && UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/clawgap-uv-cache uv pip install --python .clawgap-venv/bin/python -e .
launch_command:
mkdir -p "$HOME" && export HERMES_HOME="$HOME" && cat > "$HOME/config.yaml" <<'EOF'
model:
  default: clawgap-environment-probe
  provider: clawgap-loopback
providers:
  clawgap-loopback:
    name: ClawGap Loopback Fixture
    base_url: http://127.0.0.1:${CLAWGAP_PROVIDER_PORT}/v1
    default_model: clawgap-environment-probe
    model: clawgap-environment-probe
    key_env: CLAWGAP_FAKE_PROVIDER_KEY
    api_mode: chat_completions
EOF
.clawgap-venv/bin/hermes --model clawgap-environment-probe --provider clawgap-loopback --toolsets file -z 'environment probe'
